comment: Benzene-handler stereo fixtures (BL-03 gap closure, 2026-05-03). All entries are sourced from real benchmark CSV rows per D-23. Aromatic benzene rings cannot themselves carry ring-atom stereo (sp2 carbons are not stereocenters), so the benzene wiring's primary value is to (a) populate features.benzene_atom_to_locant via _ring_atom_to_locant_from_oriented (D-06 / D-08) and (b) ensure no false-positive injection when stereo lives on substituent atoms (D-09). The OPSIN round-trip (D-16) is xfail-marked per-fixture only when a known handler-output-format bug or OPSIN-side parsing limitation is in play; the P-91 format-compliance check (Task 1 refactor) ALWAYS runs.

compounds.comment: 1-[4-(hydroxymethyl)phenyl]hexan-1-ol — benzene with chiral substituent. Phase 152 benzene Tier-A injector correctly does not add a ring-level stereo prefix (D-09 — stereocenter is on substituent, not ring).
compounds.xfail_reason: stereocenter is on substituent (hexyl) chain, not on ring; Phase 152 wiring correctly defers per D-09.

compounds.comment: 3-(1-hydroxypentyl)phenol — meta-phenol with chiral pentyl-OH substituent. Same D-09 deferral as CHEBI:211889; second corpus point.
compounds.xfail_reason: stereocenter is on substituent (pentyl) chain; Phase 152 correctly defers per D-09.

compounds.comment: (2R)-hydroxy(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetic acid — para-hydroxyphenyl with chiral COOH-CH(OH) substituent. Acid-bearing benzene with stereocenter on alpha-carbon of principal chain.
compounds.xfail_reason: stereocenter is on the principal-chain alpha carbon (substituent of benzene); Phase 152 benzene wiring defers per D-09.

compounds.comment: (2Z)-3-phenylprop-2-enamide — benzene with E/Z near-parent double bond (cinnamic-acid-amide style). Real corpus row from opsin_selftest_500.csv (canonical OPSIN-parseable name). NOT xfail-marked — this fixture exercises the benzene Tier-A injection path through to OPSIN round-trip per BL-04 gap closure.

(4E,6E)-1,7-diphenylhepta-4,6-dien-3-one — chain ketone with two phenyl substituents and two E double bonds. Real opsin_selftest_500.csv row. NOT xfail-marked — second non-xfail benzene fixture per BL-04 gap closure (need >=2 cases that reach the OPSIN round-trip step).
